text:
sara: AtlasForge sent an RFI asking for an edge POC that runs inside their datacenter appliance. Key asks: support for a 4-bit quantized chat model, offline inference (no egress), EU export controls, and a 3-week evaluation window. can we map features + high-level costs?

kevin: big Q: do we have a runtime that supports 4-bit quant artifacts and still keeps KV-cache compatibility across warm restarts? also need expected memory footprint for a 13B-style model.

lucas: we can support 4-bit (specific q4_0/q4_k_m etc) with our slim-runtime image, but warn: 4-bit increases noise in some instruction-following evals. warm-restart KV persistence is supported if we enable disk-backed KV and set the same caching key. footprint estimate for 13B quant: ~6-8GB GPU VRAM when using sliced attention + inference config tweaks.

kevin: good. can you paste a trimmed capability table we can include in the RFI response? keep it one page.

lucas: pasted (CSV):
```
feature,supported,notes
edge_appliance_install,yes,customer-hosted docker image with minimal runtime
offline_inference,yes,no egress option; telemetry disabled in slim image
quantization_support,4-bit/8-bit,validated q4_0 and q8_0 variants; perf varies by workload
kv_persistence,yes,disk-backed KV cache for warm restarts
hsm_byok,partial,requires local HSM adapter; list of supported vendors attached
slo_for_eval,operational-target,p95 < 400ms on dedicated node; not a contractual SLA
integration_engineer_days,3,onsite or remote 3 days for integration support
```

kevin: nice. for pricing — propose two offers: (A) Appliance license + support (one-time + annual), (B) Short-term dedicated pods hosted by Redwood in EU with private control plane. back-of-envelope numbers? we need a procurement-ready line item.

lucas: back-of-envelope: option A (appliance): one-time infra license $12k (includes 3 deployment images + docs) + integration engineering $6k (3 days), support add-on $2k/month. Option B (hosted dedicated EU pods for 3 weeks): ~$9k upfront + $1.5k for managed support. These are estimates — include assumptions.

legal-bot: Flags: AtlasForge requested SOC2 Type II report excerpt and export-control questionnaire around cryptographic strength for quantized models. also need DPA and data processing addendum for EU residency. If they want local HSM, we need to confirm allowed vendors and run a technical security review.

kevin: do we have a short wording for the export-controls / cryptography Q? they asked if the inference engine is "cryptographically exportable" given the quant pipeline.

lucas: suggested wording: "Our inference runtime does not embed cryptographic modules beyond standard TLS for control plane. Quantization is a numeric compression technique and does not change cryptographic status. For POCs requiring FIPS or export-control reviews, we will cooperate with a technical attestation and list of cryptographic libraries in use."

sara: perfect. can someone spin a demo env and a slim image for them? they want offline mode and no telemetry during the POC.

deploy-bot: Demo env build queued: edge-appliance-6789. Image tag: redwood/slim-runtime:edge-2026-03. Telemetry disabled flag set. ETA ~90 minutes. Note: offline mode will block control-plane analytics; audit logs will be written to local file only.

kevin: also attach a short runbook snippet for their infra team to run the appliance and a minimal healthcheck.

lucas: runbook snippet:
```
# start appliance (container mode)
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 \
  -e REDWOOD_MODE=offline \
  -v /var/redwood/kv:/kv \
  redwood/slim-runtime:edge-2026-03 

# healthcheck
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health | jq
```

sara: procurement asked for an invoice line for the appliance + eng days. can billing draft a purchase order sample with these line items?

kevin: yes i'll ask billing. include: "Edge Appliance License (one-time)", "Integration services (3 days)", "Support (monthly) or Hosted Dedicated (3-week commit)" as alternatives.

legal-bot: I'll prep the DPA template and a checklist for the security review. drop the contact for AtlasForge procurement (tim@atlasforge.example) here so I can loop them in.

sara: contact is tim@atlasforge.example. I'll send the RFI response tomorrow 08:30 PT with the cap table, pricing options, runbook, and legal checklist. :rocket: 

lucas: I'll also export the supported HSM vendor list to Drive and link it.

deploy-bot: environment ready at 3412346220. image sha256: abcdef123456... (internal).
